cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.12)
project(ffmpeg VERSION 8.1)

add_library(ffmpeg INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(ffmpeg INTERFACE include)
if(WIN32)
    set(FFMEPG_LIB_PATH lib/windows_x86_64)
    find_library(AVCODEC_LIB NAMES avcodec.lib PATHS ${FFMEPG_LIB_PATH} NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
    find_library(SWSCALE_LIB NAMES swscale.lib PATHS ${FFMEPG_LIB_PATH} NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
    find_library(AVUTIL_LIB NAMES avutil.lib PATHS ${FFMEPG_LIB_PATH} NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
else()
    set(FFMEPG_LIB_PATH lib/linux_x86_64)
    find_library(AVCODEC_LIB NAMES libavcodec.a PATHS ${FFMEPG_LIB_PATH} NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
    find_library(SWSCALE_LIB NAMES libswscale.a PATHS ${FFMEPG_LIB_PATH} NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
    find_library(AVUTIL_LIB NAMES libavutil.a PATHS ${FFMEPG_LIB_PATH} NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
endif()
target_link_libraries(ffmpeg INTERFACE ${AVCODEC_LIB} ${SWSCALE_LIB} ${AVUTIL_LIB} )
